Method of Attack: Deleting various data folders without archiving or encrypting them
Creating ransom notes falsely claiming files were encrypted and demanding ransom payment
Installing own SSH key (crackit) on insecure Redis servers to gain access
Issuing commands to delete critical directories such as /var/www/, /usr/share/nginx, /var/lib/mysql/, /data/
Using insecure Redis instances as attack vector
Impacted Systems: Linux servers running insecure Redis instances
Attack Vector: Exploitation of insecure Redis servers to install SSH key and gain server access
Indicators of Compromise: Commands deleting folders: rm -rf /var/www/, rm -rf /usr/share/nginx, rm -rf /var/lib/mysql/, rm -rf /data/
